name: Vadrok
description: An apex monster who ripped Lukka from his flesh-titan.

description_citations.text: "Vivien Reid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vivien climbs a cliff and sees Vadrok swoop down to attack the titan, revealing the basin as Vadrok's nest.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vadrok burns away much of the titan with blue flame and pulls Lukka out of it.
timeline.quote: Struggling now in Vadrok's jaws was Lukka .

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vivien shoots Lukka in the chest with several arrows as he hangs in Vadrok's jaws, killing him.
timeline.quote: She pulled back one more spectral arrow and put it in the center of his chest.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina watches Vadrok toss Lukka's corpse aside and burn what remains of the titan.
timeline.quote: So passes the captain of the Specials

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vivien steps in front of the survivors to keep Vadrok from attacking them, and Vadrok flies away.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vadrok's flame vaporizes Lukka's amalgam and more omenpaths of Realmbreaker open to Ikoria.
timeline.quote: After Lukka's amalgam was vaporized by Vadrok 's flame, more of Realmbreaker 's omenpaths opened to Ikoria.

citation.text: "Ikoria", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jirina bluffs and leads the survivors and Lukka into Vadrok's lair, where Vadrok's fire destroys him and Vivien's arrows and Vadrok finish him.
timeline.quote: Vadrok's magical fire obliterated Lukka's massive form

citation.text: "Lukka", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan, and Lukka is burned and finished off by Vivien.
timeline.quote: Lukka was then burned by Vadrok's ethereal fire and finished off by Vivien

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vadrok kills the compleated Lukka on Ikoria.
timeline.quote: Vadrok kills Lukka and spares Vivien and the refugees.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the invasion Vivien helps defend Ikoria; Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan and Vivien finishes him with three spectral arrows.
timeline.quote: She finished the apex monster's work, planting three spectral arrows in Lukka's chest.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A catlike dragon, the apex monster of Raugrin, who attacks the Phyrexian titan and tears Lukka out of it.
